Question: Using NHANES from 2011 to 2014 we will run a weighted logistic regression using exam weights where the predictor is adult food security category, categorized as severe food insecurity for participants who reported very low food security or low food security, mild food insecurity for participants who reported marginal food security, and food secure for who reported full food security and outcome is depression which is based on the total score from the nine questions "have little interest in doing things", "feeling down, depressed, or hopeless", "trouble sleeping or sleeping too much", "feeling tired or having little energy", "poor appetite or overeating", "feeling bad about yourself", "trouble concentrating on things", "moving or speaking slowly or too fast", "thought you would be better off dead", calculated where each question has value of Not at all (0), Several days (1), More than half the days (2), Nearly every day (3), if value is null assign (0), and the total score >=10 was defined as clinically relevant depression and else was not. We will include adults aged 20 or older, who have diabetes defined as meeting any of the following: fasting plasma glucose (mg/dl) >126, self-reported diabetes or borderline or reported taking diabetes medication. We will exclude participants with missing values for adult food security category and any of the nine depression questions "have little interest in doing things", "feeling down, depressed, or hopeless", "trouble sleeping or sleeping too much", "feeling tired or having little energy", "poor appetite or overeating", "feeling bad about yourself", "trouble concentrating on things", "moving or speaking slowly or too fast", "thought you would be better off dead".

Inclusion Criteria:
- age >= 20

Exclusion Criteria:
- missing adult food security category
- missing "have little interest in doing things"

- missing "trouble sleeping or sleeping too much"

- missing "feeling bad about yourself"
- missing "trouble concentrating on things"
- missing "moving or speaking slowly or too fast"
- missing "thought you would be better off dead"

Covariates:
- None

Predictor:
- adult food security category categorized as:
  - "severe food insecurity" if adult food security category = "very low food security" OR adult food security category = "low food security"
  - "mild food insecurity" if adult food security category = "marginal food security"
  - "food secure" if adult food security category = "full food security"

Outcome:
- depression = 1 if total score >= 10; 0 otherwise
  total score calculated as the sum of the scores from the following nine questions:
  - "have little interest in doing things"
  - "feeling down, depressed, or hopeless"
  - "trouble sleeping or sleeping too much"
  - "feeling tired or having little energy"
  - "poor appetite or overeating"
  - "feeling bad about yourself"
  - "trouble concentrating on things"
  - "moving or speaking slowly or too fast"
  - "thought you would be better off dead"
  Each question's score is defined as:
  - Not at all = 0
  - Several days = 1
  - More than half the days = 2
  - Nearly every day = 3
  - If value is null, assign 0
